 Drew Mestemaker questionable vs. ASU, Omarion Miller ruled out
 Mestemaker leads FBS quarterbacks in passing yards (3,239) and touchdowns (30), albeit while also leading the Big 12 in interceptions (10).
 BY DAMON ALLRED

 Updated: Nov 19, 2026, 11:52 am

 Oklahoma State quarterback Drew Mestemaker, potentially the top 2027 NFL Draft pick , was questionable on the initial Big 12 availability report for Saturday’s game at Arizona State.
 ASU will be without wide receiver Omarion Miller in the matchup, as he was ruled out (undisclosed).
 Mestemaker suffered a stinger on his throwing shoulder in Oklahoma State’s previous game against Texas Tech. He played all but seven snaps but was receiving treatment on the sideline between drives.
 ADVERTISEMENT 
 “Drew’s a tough kid and obviously was able to finish the game, so we’ll just continue to monitor how he feels,” Oklahoma State head coach Eric Morris told reporters Monday. “He’s as tough as they come. … He communicates at a high level, so just continuing to communicate this week.”
 Mestemaker leads FBS quarterbacks in passing yards (3,239) and touchdowns (30), albeit while also leading the Big 12 in interceptions (10).
 He also led the nation in passing yards (4,379) last season at North Texas before he, the coaching staff and many teammates made the offseason move to Oklahoma State.
 Oklahoma State’s backup is freshman Brodie Vehrs, a Chandler Basha High School product ranked by 247 Sports as the No. 179 quarterback in the 2026 class.
 Vehrs was originally committed to Northern Arizona before flipping to the Morris staff at North Texas, again switching the commitment after the coaches made their move. The freshman is 11 of 16 for 105 yards and one touchdown this season. He also has five carries for 48 yards.
 ASU head coach Kenny Dillingham said he called the Oklahoma State staff — he’s close with offensive coordinator Sean Brophy — after he saw Vehrs up close when the quarterback won ASU’s passing tournament ahead of his senior year at Basha in summer 2025.
 “I was like, ‘Man, you guys got a really, really good one.’ Super impressive person and the times he’s been on the field this year, he’s been impressive,” Dillingham said Wednesday.
 ASU’s Omarion Miller out vs. Oklahoma State
 Miller has been ASU’s second-most productive receiver behind Biletnikoff Award finalist Reed Harris. He is top 10 in catches among Big 12 players (49) with 525 yards (21st) and three touchdowns (28th).
 ASU and freshman quarterback Jake Fette will miss how he threatens defenses downfield in a matchup that could become a shootout, as the Cowboys have allowed at least 50 points in two of their last three games.
 ADVERTISEMENT 
 Look for Derek Eusebio to get more targets as a result.
 Eusebio has 21 catches for 187 yards over the past five games since putting an injury behind him, adding 10 rushing yards on three carries and a 28-yard pass.
 ASU-Oklahoma State Big 12 availability report
 drew mestemaker is questionable for asu-oklahoma state on the initial big 12 availability report.

 Oklahoma State linebacker Tate Romney being doubtful for the game is noteworthy, as he was a three-year Sun Devil who is having a career year with the Cowboys to the tune of 63 tackles, seven tackles for loss, 1.5 sacks and one forced fumble.
